title: Guarded body initialization
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with at least one work tape, let $q_v,q_i$ be states of $B$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Suppose that, from its initial configuration on $x$, with all work tapes blank, $B$ halts at time $T$ and outputs $w$ consecutive true bits. Then for some $t\le 3T+|x|+3w+10$, the body machine with parameters $B,q_v,q_i$ and stopped flag false, started in its initial configuration on $x$, reaches the anchor on the seam carrying $w$ false bits on tape zero and blank contents on all other tapes; at every time $j<t$, its state is not the anchor state.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$B$ has at least one work tape
the run of $B$ from its initial configuration on $x$ halts at time $T$
that run outputs $w$ copies of true
replaced:
Let $B$ be a source machine with at least one work tape that, from the empty
